wallAnonBody: Ukubhalisa kwamahala nokusheshako kukunikela ukufuna oku-10 ngelanga, nazo zoke iinhlathululo, izibonelo, Izaga neenkulumo noMsuka welizwi.
wallBasicBody: I-akhawunti yamahala ifaka ukufuna oku-10 ngelanga. Umkhawulo uthoma butjha kusasa, namkha ulinge i-Individual bona uthole ukufuna ngaphandle komkhawulo, izithombe nawo woke amathulusi wokufunda.
sayPaidBody: Kutjho kuyingcenye yamahlelo we-Individual, Family ne-Schools.
famSingleChild: Kunomfundi munye kwaphela ekhaya? I-Individual ngu-{price} ngenyanga. Ngokwengezelela kancani, i-Family yengeza abantwana abafika ku-5.
featFamPeople: Umntwana ngamunye uthola woke amathulusi, ngeModi yabantwana. Umbelethi ubhadela kanye ngomndeni woke.
partnersCalcNote: Isilinganiso sisekelwe ehlelweni le-Individual nesilinganiso sama-25%. Amakhasimende wonyaka, we-Family ne-Schools ayasikhulisa.
helpSwitchA1: Vula ikhasi lakho le-Akhawunti bese uthinta "Tjhentjhela ku-Family". Ukubhalisela kwakho kwanje kubuyekezwa ekarada efanako, ngaphandle kokuyifaka godu.
helpSwitchA2: I-Stripe ibala umehluko wamalanga asele esikhathini sanje, ngalokho ubhadela umehluko kwaphela.
helpChargeA1: Ukubhadeliswa kuvela njenge-GADIT namkha GADIT.APP. I-Individual ngu-$3.99 ngenyanga namkha u-$39.99 ngomnyaka, kanti i-Family ngu-$5.99 ngenyanga namkha u-$59 ngomnyaka. E-Israel ukubhadeliswa kungamashekeli: ₪14.90 namkha ₪149 we-Individual, ₪19.90 namkha ₪199 we-Family. Ukubhalisela kwangaphambi kwaka-Oktoba 2026 kugcina inani ebekuthome ngalo. Nange inani lingafani, kungenzeka livela kwenye isevisi.
helpCompareQ: Uyini umehluko phakathi kwe-Basic, Individual ne-Family?
helpCompareA1: I-Basic (mahala): ukufuna amezwi okufika ku-10 ngelanga, zoke iinhlathululo, izibonelo, Izaga neenkulumo, uMsuka welizwi nebhuku lamezwi elinamezwi afika ku-30.
helpCompareA2: Individual ($3.99 a month or $39.99 a year, ₪14.90 or ₪149 in Israel): umuntu oyedwa, woke amathulusi. Ukufuna amagama okunganamkhawulo, isithombe encazelweni ngayinye, incazelo efaneleko emtjhweni, Every Word, Say it, yenza umutjho ngependulo, imitjho eminengi yesibonelo nemibuzo ngelilinye nelilinye igama, iphimbo lemvelo lokufundela phezulu, ukusebenzisa ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, imidlalo, imibuzo nemincintiswano yamagama, nokuzilolonga okuhlakaniphileko ngokulungiselela isivivinyo nedikitheyishini.
helpCompareA3: I-Family ($5.99 ngenyanga namkha $59 ngomnyaka, ₪19.90 namkha ₪199 e-Israel): koke okuku-Individual kwabantwana abafika ku-5 nababelethi boke ababili, kunye neModi yabantwana, indawo yakhe yomntwana ngamunye, ideshibhodi yababelethi enezaziso zamezwi, noKupela kwesikolo.
remSubject: Lotjha {name}, ukulinga kwakho kwe-Gadit kuphela emalangeni amabili
remBody:
Lotjha {name},

Ukulinga kwakho kwamahala kwe-Gadit kuphela ngo-{date}.

## Kwenzekani ngemva kwalokho
Ngelanga lelo ikarada yakho izakubhadeliswa {amount} {cycle} ye-{plan}.

Awutlhogi ukwenza litho bona uragele phambili.

## Indlela yokukhansela
Ungakhansela nanyana kunini ngaphambi kwaka-{date} begodu angekhe ubhadeliswe litho.

1. Vula [ikhasi lakho le-akhawunti](/account).
2. Thinta "Lawula ukubhadela".
3. Ekhasini elivulekako, khetha ukukhansela ukubhalisela.
pupBody:
Lotjha {name},

Siyathokoza ngokusebenzisa i-Gadit ku-Android.

I-akhawunti yakho nje iku-Basic.

Ungathola woke amathulusi ngamahlelo we-Individual ne-Family.

## Family

Yababelethi nabantwana.

Abantwana abafika ku-5, ngamunye unebhuku lakhe lamezwi, iModi yabantwana nedeshibhodi yababelethi.

## Individual

Yomuntu munye.

Ukufuna ngaphandle komkhawulo nawo woke amathulusi.

Woke amabili athoma ngamalanga ali-14 mahala.

Ungakhansela nanyana kunini ngaphambi kobana ukulinga kuphele begodu angekhe ubhadeliswe litho.

Nawusubhalisile, i-app izakuzibuyekeza yona ngokwayo.

Ngena nje nge-akhawunti efanako.
